AMD FSR SDK (FidelityFX SDK) 2.4.0 - license for the files New AA ships

New AA includes these unmodified files from AMD's FSR SDK 2.4.0
(https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, tag v2.4.0):

    amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll      Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin/amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll
    amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll    Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin/amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll

New AA's FSR bindings (Source/FsrNative.cs) follow the declarations in the SDK's ffx_api.h, ffx_api_types.h,
vk/ffx_api_vk.h and ffx_upscale.h. The SDK's docs/license.md lists all of these files under the following license:

persons to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

Software.
